notes:
This is an early build, released to consoles set to Latest Updates.

Pokemon: Gen1Recomp is updated to 0.3.42 and now plays Silver, Crystal,
FireRed, LeafGreen and Emerald as well as Red, Blue, Yellow and Gold.
FireRed, LeafGreen and Emerald are in beta. Add a game's ROM on the web page
and it gets its own tile on Ports and Apps. Each game prepares itself from
its ROM on its first launch, and once more after this update. Games started
from the all-games launcher open in focus again.

PC Games: an installer can now install a game straight onto the SD card:
pick drive Y: (SD card) in the installer. A game's new Install to setting
keeps a game on the console's own storage instead. Deleting a PC game also
removes its entry in Windows' installed programs and its shortcuts. A game
that stops on "Unable to load function" turns on full x87 precision by
itself for its next launch; the setting is also in the game's settings.
Adding a game's Linux version (a .sh file) now says to add the Windows
version instead.

The on-screen keyboard is now a strip along the bottom of the screen, so
the game stays in view above it, and closing it no longer leaves the screen
black in PC games and Morrowind.

On the web page, Browse all files, next to the storage readout on the Files
tab, lists everything on the SD card and the console's storage with sizes,
and can rename and delete in your home folder and on the SD card.

Fixes: a console set up with the SCCM Retro app showed the SD card as 0 B
and uploads said it was not mounted. An SD card write that came a minute
after the previous one could fail, which could leave a PC game install
unrecorded.

stable.notes:
The 2.41 changes, now on the Stable channel. If this console was on 2.40.0,
it also gets the whole 2.40 series, summed up at the end.

This update carries a new boot script: the console restarts once for the
update and once more on its own about a minute after the first boot. Do not
power off while it says part 2 of 2.

The SD card's fastest mode (DDR200) is now used on Samsung cards only, as
Switchroot does. Other cards run in the standard mode: if yours used the
fast mode, games load a little slower, but SanDisk cards, which cannot run
it reliably on the Switch, no longer get read errors under load. If a
Samsung card gives read errors, turn DDR200 off in the SCCM Retro app's Boot
settings.

The SCCM Retro app on the Homebrew menu is now one app: Launch SCCM Retro,
Launch in Safe Mode (stock clocks and voltages, once), Options (WiFi and
Bluetooth, boot settings, auto launch), and installing or removing SCCM
Retro on an SD card. The separate installer and calibration apps are
removed.

Swap A and B now applies only to Gen1Recomp and Moonlight, the two games
that offer it.

New background: Arcade, in Settings, Display and Sound, Appearance.

From 2.40.0, also: the console boots in about 28 seconds instead of about
50; Ocarina of Time and Majora's Mask, and Mario Kart Wii as a native port
with Retro Rewind online, on Ports and Apps; a PC Games tab for Windows
games; auto save for RetroArch, 3DS and PS2 games; Wii U, GameCube, WiFi
and volume button fixes; and a security fix to install permissions.
